BOS.note: Tatum returns healthy. Over cap, under first apron. Established core, limited flexibility, minor trade exceptions.

DET.note: Young core (Cunningham, Duren, Thompson) with developing contracts. Good cap flexibility. Potential buyer.

ORL.note: Young core on large deals, pushing them over first apron. Limited cap flexibility; likely stand-pat.

TOR.note: Over tax line, under first apron. Barnes on max. Poeltl/Barrett are movable contracts. Likely minor buyer/stand-pat.

GSW.note: Second apron team with high payroll. Curry, Butler, Green on large deals. Expiring contracts offer trade flexibility.

MEM.note: Young core (Boozer, Edey) leads retool. Morant traded. High upside, potential trade activity for point guard.

NOP.note: Zion on max deal. Over cap, under tax. Young talent, but injury concerns. Likely stand-pat.

OKC.note: Young, talented core with large extensions. Over first apron, under second. Buyer for complementary pieces.

POR.note: Morant acquired. Young core developing. Over cap, under first apron. Trades are primary path to improve.
